unit.why: A quotation from Divrei Menachem (Va-etchanan) that mentions R. Elimelech's habit of stopping his ears on Shabbat at the proclamations, only to support an exegesis of 'ושמעת ישראל'; it gives a described habit but no narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: One of a series of short quoted passages on Shabbat holiness; the previous and next divisions are similar quotations.
